value.name: Asha infers Daniel seeks a specific document
value.description: Asha realizes Daniel's repeated mention of something old means he is looking for a particular document and thinks she may already have it.
evidence: The repetition of the word told her what the first use had only suggested, that he was looking for a particular document and believed she might already be holding it.

value.name: Asha delays her answer
value.description: Asha pauses before answering Daniel, watching his smile stay fixed while she gauges his intentions.
evidence: She let the answer wait a beat longer than was comfortable, watching the smile hold itself in place

value.name: Asha notices Daniel avoids naming the document
value.description: Asha observes that Daniel has not denied expecting something, but has refused to say what it is.
evidence: noted that he had not denied expecting something, only declined to name it

value.name: Overturned drawer remains as evidence
value.description: The overturned drawer on the rug underscores that something has been searched or disturbed, and neither person is ready to address it.
evidence: Between them the overturned drawer lay on the rug like evidence neither of them was ready to discuss

value.name: Asha asks which old paper Daniel wants
value.description: Asha directly asks Daniel which specific old paper he expects to find.
evidence: Asha kept her face still and asked him which old paper, exactly, he expected to find.

value.name: Daniel avoids answering directly
value.description: Daniel refuses to identify the paper and instead shifts the conversation away from the question.
evidence: Daniel did not answer it directly.

value.name: Daniel hides the bank statements
value.description: Daniel picks up the rubber-banded bundle of bank statements and places it behind him on a chair, removing it from Asha's reach.
evidence: Instead he gathered the rubber-banded bundle off the corner of the desk, set it on the chair behind him as though tidying
the bank statements moved out of her reach

value.name: Daniel steps back and probes upstairs rooms
value.description: Daniel retreats from the desk and asks whether Asha has searched other upstairs rooms, including the linen closet and cedar chest.
evidence: and stepped back from the furniture with a smile that did not reach the rest of his face
He asked, with the same careful lightness he had used before, whether there were other rooms upstairs she hadn't gone through yet, the linen closet maybe, the cedar chest at the foot of the bed

value.name: Asha registers Daniel's evasiveness
value.description: Asha mentally catalogs Daniel's fixed smile, the moved bank statements, and his continued refusal to name what he wants.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for
